# antscope2

**RigExpert's own analyzer software, for their antenna analyzers**

- **Version recorded:** 2.0.2
- **Categories:** `antenna-analysers`
- **Upstream:** <https://rigexpert.com/software/antscope2/>

## What it does

Talks to RigExpert antenna analyzers (AA-series, Stick-series) over USB, drives sweeps, and plots SWR, R/X and Smith charts, with cable compensation and measurement export.

## Why you would want it

It is the vendor's own software and the only Linux program that speaks to every current RigExpert model. For the models flaa supports, flaa is the lighter open alternative; for the rest this is the option.

## Before it will work

A RigExpert analyzer. Most models enumerate as a USB CDC serial device -- membership of `dialout` covers those. AHRL additionally shipped a udev rule opening 0483:a1de (some models' custom USB interface) to MODE 0666; this catalog has not yet carried a RigExpert entry in the hardware catalog, so on such models the device may need root until it does.

## Install and launch

- **Installed by name only** — it is in no profile.
- **Install:** `hammunition install antscope2 --dry-run`, read the plan, then run it without `--dry-run`.
- **Launch:** Its package ships its own commands and application-menu entry; a unit that ships none gets a generated terminal entry (**D-050**). `hammunition status` lists what is installed.
- **The install needs the network to:** the upstream files the plan lists, each checked against a pinned digest (or, for map and reference data, the publisher or a LAN mirror).

## Offline use

*Not yet documented for this application.* Read “Before it will work” above for what it needs; the install-time network line above is the only offline fact generated from the manifest. Internet, a local network and a radio link are three different things, and this page does not claim any of them works until it says so.

## How it installs

- prebuilt deb from https://rigexpert.com/files/software/Antscope/antscope2forlinux/antscope2_2.0.2_ubuntu.deb — *arch x86_64*

## Known problems

x86_64 only -- the vendor ships no ARM build and AHRL's compile attempt on aarch64 failed. The .deb installs the whole application under /usr/antscope2/ with a launcher script, not into standard paths, and its control metadata (version "1.0", architecture "all") does not match the filename or payload.

## Keeping it current

- probe: none
- strategy: reinstall
- New builds appear as new filenames in rigexpert.com/files/software/Antscope/antscope2forlinux/ with no feed and no changelog. Check when a new analyzer model is not recognised.

## Where to get help with the software itself

RigExpert's own support channels; source at github.com/rigexpert/AntScope2.
